v5_change.observed: every policy worker log on PRO 6000 prints "[svulkan2] [error] OIDN Error: invalid handle" per camera per step; bs1 (2080 Ti, same image) never does. First-frame Laplacian std of the 320x240 head camera: cluster job 1685 adjust_bottle 22.6 vs bs1 video 12.1 (reports/oidn-blackwell-noise-compare.png)
v5_change.cause: RoboTwin always enables rt shader + OIDN denoiser; SAPIEN 3.0.0b1 bundles OIDN 2.0.1 (pre-Blackwell); the CUDA device fails and frames stay un-denoised
v5_change.fix: launcher downloads OIDN 2.3.3 (sha256 3c385230d9e6f63527ba72f2229594dbac5051674219d72e0044b5d0b841796f), binds lib/*.so* over sapien/oidn_library and docker/oidn/_oidn_tricks.py over sapien/_oidn_tricks.py, verifies checksums and runs a rt+oidn render probe (OIDN_PASS, reports/launchers/<job>/oidn-probe.json)
v5_change.also: episode timeout 1800 -> 3600 s after job 1686 aborted on place_bread_basket episode-0001 timeout
v5_change.consequence: Fast-WAM results of jobs 1685 and 1686 discarded; pool, provenance and policy identity unchanged; OIDN version recorded per job by the probe
